heading: Enforcement authority
lead: Subject to guidelines approved by the Secretary, members of the Coast Guard, in the performance of official duties, may—

tree.text: while at a facility (as defined in section 70101 of title 46)—

children.text: make an arrest without warrant for any offense against the United States committed in their presence; and
seize property as otherwise provided by law.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 99 of this title as this section.
